purpose: Teach: 吸着/触発/技量/施術/力説/肝炎/訪米/致死

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、フィルターの吸着性能を改良しろ
lines.en: I want our filter's adsorption performance improved.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive opening. Direct gaze and even tone. Expectation is implicit—no room for negotiation. Clean pace, no breath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員を触発するイベントを企画します
lines.en: Understood. I'll design an event to inspire the staff.
lines.style: Brisk acknowledgment. Slight nod on 「はい」. Methodical cadence—ticking off the task as received. Calm efficiency, no inflection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の技量を可視化しろ
lines.en: Make our employees' skill levels visible and measurable.
lines.style: Clear directive, same cool register. Emphasis lands on 「可視化」—the actionable outcome. Steady tempo. No warmth, no rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。施術機器メーカーとの提携を検討中です
lines.en: Understood. We're currently in talks with surgical equipment makers about a partnership.
lines.style: Progress report tone. Measured pace. Slight lean forward—updating the boss on active work. Professional but not stiff, showing initiative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新製品の優位性を市場に力説しろ
lines.en: Get our new product's competitive edge in front of the market. Make the case strongly.
lines.style: Emphatic but controlled. Weight on 「力説しろ」—the persuasion part matters. Lean back slightly. Tone expects follow-through, not discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。肝炎関連の医療事業にも参入を検討します
lines.en: Understood. We're also exploring entry into hepatitis-related medical services.
lines.style: Steady report voice. Demonstrating scope—showing he's already thinking broader. Slight pause before 「医療事業」, letting it land. Calm confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社長の訪米日程を調整しろ
lines.en: Coordinate the president's schedule for his US visit.
lines.style: Final directive, slightly quieter pitch. Same precision as earlier commands. A task that will require coordination. Expectation is clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品の致死的リスクをゼロにする目標で進めます
lines.en: Understood. We're setting our sights on bringing the product's lethal risk down to zero.
lines.style: Closing statement, grave undertone. 「ゼロにする」lands with quiet weight—this is the stakes. Even pace, no hesitation. Professional gravity.
